title: Encoded pair layout
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $a$, form a list of bit sources by taking, for each $i=0,\ldots,n-1$, two consecutive copies of input bit $i$, then the constants $0$ and $1$, and then, for each $j=0,\ldots,a-1$, input bit $n+j$.
